Unchanged monetary policy – target range for the three-month Libor rate remains at 1.25%-2.25%
Unchanged monetary policy – target range for the three-month Libor rate remains at 1.25%-2.25%
The National Bank has decided to adhere to its current monetary policy.
The National Bank has decided to adhere to its current monetary policy.
It is leaving the target range for the three-month Libor rate unchanged at 1.25% to 2.25%.
It is leaving the target range for the three-month Libor rate unchanged at 1.25% to 2.25%.
For the time being, the three-month Libor is to be kept in the middle of the target range.
For the time being, the three-month Libor is to be kept in the middle of the target range.
During the past year, the National Bank has markedly eased its monetary policy, lowering the target range for the three-month Libor by a total of 1.75 percentage points.
